chunks: Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man whose coccyx was broken, so he could no longer control his anus. He said: "The full blood money is due."

He said: And I asked him about a man who had intercourse with a slave girl and caused ifda' to her, and when she reached that condition, she would not bear children. He said: "The full blood money is due."

key_terms.اسْتَهُ: his anus; here, the ability to control defecation
key_terms.الدِّيَةُ كَامِلَةً: the full prescribed blood money is due
key_terms.فَأَفْضَاهَا: he caused ifda' to her; a severe genital injury

ai.seo_question: What injuries require full blood money (diya) in Shia fiqh besides homicide?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings on injuries that entail full blood money (diya). It states that full diya is due both for a man whose severe bodily injury causes loss of bowel control and for a slave girl who suffers ifda' resulting in loss of childbearing ability.
